import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
	
	public static int n;
	public static int sum_k=0;
	public static Scientist[] sci;
	
	public static int count=0;
	
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		
		Scanner scn=new Scanner(System.in);
		
		n=scn.nextInt();
		sci=new Scientist[n+1];
		
		sum_k=0;
		
		count=0;
		
		for (int i = 1; i < sci.length; i++) {
			
			sci[i]=new Scientist();
			sci[i].k=scn.nextLong();
			sci[i].a=scn.nextLong();
			sci[i].x=scn.nextLong();
			sci[i].y=scn.nextLong();
			sci[i].m=scn.nextLong();
			sum_k+=sci[i].k;			

			long k=sci[i].k;
			long a=sci[i].a;
			long x=sci[i].x;
			long y=sci[i].y;
			long m=sci[i].m;
			int c=0;
			long t=0;
			while(k>1){
				t=(a*x+y)%m;
				if(t<a){
					c++;
				}
				a=t;
				k--;
			}
			if(c>count){
				count=c;
			}
			
		}
		
		scn.close();

		System.out.println(count);
		
		if(sum_k<=200000){

			ResItem[] ri=new ResItem[sum_k+1];
			ResItem[] tem=new ResItem[sum_k+1];
			
			for(int i=0;i<sum_k+1;i++){
				ri[i]=new ResItem();
				tem[i]=new ResItem();
			}
			
			int start=0;
			int end=0;
			
			while(end<sum_k){
				
				for(int j=1;j<=n;j++){
					while(sci[j].k>0){
						
						ri[end].a=sci[j].a;
						ri[end].index=j;
						end++;
						
						sci[j].a=(sci[j].a*sci[j].x+sci[j].y)%sci[j].m;
						
						sci[j].k--;

						if(sci[j].a<ri[end-1].a){
							break;
						}						
					}
				}
				
				if(end>start){
					sort(ri, tem, start, end-1);
				}
				
				start=end;

			}
			
			for(int j=0;j<end;j++){
				System.out.println(ri[j].a+" "+ri[j].index);
			}
			
		}
		
	}
	
	public static void sort(ResItem[] ri,ResItem[] tem,int l,int r){
		
		if(l>=r){
			return;
		}
		
		int mid=(l+r)/2;
		
		sort(ri,tem,l,mid);
		sort(ri, tem, mid+1, r);
		
		merge(ri,tem,l,mid,r);
		
	}
	
	public static void merge(ResItem[] ri,ResItem[] tem,int l,int mid,int r){
		
		int i=l;
		int j=mid+1;
		int k=l;
		while(i<=mid&&j<=r){
			if(ri[i].a<=ri[j].a){
				tem[k].a=ri[i].a;
				tem[k].index=ri[i].index;	
				i++;
			}else{
				tem[k].a=ri[j].a;
				tem[k].index=ri[j].index;		
				j++;
			}
			k++;
		}
		
		while(i<=mid){
			tem[k].a=ri[i].a;
			tem[k].index=ri[i].index;	
			i++;
			k++;
		}
		
		while(j<=r){
			tem[k].a=ri[j].a;
			tem[k].index=ri[j].index;		
			j++;
			k++;
		}
		
		for(k=l;k<=r;k++){
			ri[k].a=tem[k].a;
			ri[k].index=tem[k].index;
		}
		
	}
	
}

class Scientist{
	
	public long k;
	public long a;
	public long x;
	public long y;
	public long m;	
		
}

class ResItem{
	long a;
	long index;
}
